Payout of 24 July is short ₹1,647.83.
The bank credited ₹3,15,319.75 against an expected ₹3,16,967.58. 25 orders sit in this payout. 2 different combinations of ledger entries add up to this difference and nothing in the records tells them apart, so no single explanation can be given.
Suggested action: ask the gateway which entries it deducted from this payout, since the amounts alone cannot separate them.
